title: Dine with Leyi — Private Chef & Canapés, Lagos
description: Private chef, canapés and food styling in Lagos by Ayọ̀lèyí. Book a private dining experience or order a spread for your event.

hero.headlineHtml: Expressing how I feel, sometimes with food.
hero.text: Private dinners, canapé spreads and birthday tables styled to be photographed. Trusted by Reekado Banks and Toyin Abraham. Tell me your date and guest count to get started.

main.alt: Canapé spread with roses and warming lamps by Dine with Leyi

items.title: Private dining
items.text: A private chef in your home for dinners, date nights and special occasions.

items.title: Canapé spreads
items.text: Styled grazing tables and canapés that look as good as they taste.

items.title: Birthday tables
items.text: Neon signs, warming lamps and a full spread for the birthday star.

items.title: Office parties & trays
items.text: Office party menus and food trays with @sizla.ng: rice, pasta, burgers, BBQ and more.

feature.title: The cooking & styling class
feature.text: A hands-on class on cooking for events, building canapé spreads and styling food for the camera. On the live site students see the dates, register and pay online, and get class details by email.
feature.ctaMsg: On the live site this opens class registration with Paystack payment.

booking.title: Book Leyi for your event
booking.text: Send your date, guest count and the kind of experience you want, and I'll come back with a menu and quote.
terms: Based in Lagos. Spreads include setup and styling.
A deposit confirms your date and menu.
booking.termsNote: Deposit and setup terms are samples. The live site would use Leyi's own terms.
